outcome_rationale: The C42.27-31 architecture is operationally sufficient for practical local/in-house use as the in-house Diagnostic & Forensic Agent. The complete real repository master scenario (Phase 7) executed end-to-end against real mutation evidence (440 killed, 75.6% score) and produced a deterministic CERTIFIABLE verdict. 24/26 agent capabilities are CERTIFIED; 1 is PARTIALLY_CERTIFIED (CI evidence ingestion — logic + local/CI equivalence done & tested, live CI emission not yet wired). The remaining gaps are operational (CI wiring) and data-accumulation (escalation threshold), NOT fundamental architectural weaknesses.
why_not_outcome_b: No concrete architectural gap prevents real use. The single PARTIALLY_CERTIFIED item (CI ingestion) has working canonical logic and tests; only live workflow emission remains, which is an operational boundary clearly marked rather than a blocking gap.
why_not_outcome_c: No fundamental architectural weakness remains. The framework determines minimum defensible verification, reuses valid evidence, classifies survivors, proposes bounded strengthening, validates without full campaigns, and certifies deterministically. Shared-infrastructure invalidation (cross-engine-impact gap) is an enhancement, not a structural defect — single-engine change paths are fully safe and validated.
why_not_outcome_d: Real-world execution evidence IS available: the Phase 7 master scenario ran the actual mutmut pipeline on credit_card_engine and produced a complete forensic record + diagnostic verdict. This is not a validation gap requiring invented confidence.
next_work_phase: OUTCOME A transition: move from M9-C42 architectural construction into operational deployment, usability, hardening, and controlled integration. Specifically: (1) wire live CI evidence emission into mutation.yml / backend-verify.yml (resolve Phase 2 PARTIALLY_CERTIFIED item); (2) accumulate real strengthening approval/revalidation data to define the CLASS-E escalation threshold (resolve repeated-survivor gap); (3) implement shared-infrastructure invalidation rule (resolve cross-engine-impact gap) as an enhancement.
authorization_boundary_confirmed: Agent autonomy is correctly bounded (autonomy-boundary.json). No prohibited action (production modification, auto-approval, scope expansion, full campaigns, failure suppression, policy change) is possible through the implemented code paths.
